title: Independent AIM characterization of Au···Au contacts in a tetranuclear gold(I) cation
difficulty_reasons: Heavy-atom tetracation requires a defensible relativistic electronic-structure treatment.
The agent must validate four named BCPs and report multiple coupled QTAIM observables while independently choosing the computational route.
The qualitative author hypothesis is disclosed, but the quantitative bonding result must be independently reproduced and interpreted.

paper.title: Tetranuclear Gold(I) Complexes Bearing Imidazo[1,5-b]pyridazin-7-ylidene Ligands: Synthesis and Catalytic Applications in Nucleophilic Addition to Alkynes

data.description: Pinned CCDC record and deterministic extraction/state definition for the anion-free tetranuclear Au(I) cation.

required_deliverables.description: Validated calculation provenance, geometry/BCP checks, per-contact AIM observables, classification, conclusion and limitations.
